title: Choose the look for the Health Club app
question: The roll assigned Sunrise. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sunrise
options.lineage: the morning sky over a horizon line, the daily ritual every member already lives
options.thesis: Every day starts as a dawn. Finishing today's plan literally raises the sun and warms the whole app.
materials: sky gradient that shifts with today's progress
options.viewport: Today screen: greeting and streak at top, a big horizon arc where today's sun sits at the height of your progress, the next workout as one large start button, tab bar for Today, Workouts, Progress, Me.
options.risk: Sky gradients can turn into wallpaper; the sun has to be the data, never decoration.

raised.raise: Finished workouts stamp onto the week and never disappear; a missed day stays as a calm unlit dawn, never a red X.
Every state reads by shape as well as colour: lit, half-lit and unlit suns, so colour-blind members lose nothing.
In the workout player each move's bar is exactly as long as its seconds, so you see how much is left at a glance.

options.label: Fridge Calendar
options.lineage: the paper month calendar on the fridge with gold star stickers
options.thesis: Every workout earns a gold star on a month grid everyone in the family recognizes.
options.viewport: Today screen led by this month's calendar filling with gold stars, today's workout pinned like a magnet note.
options.risk: The most familiar idea on my list; warm and clear, but less of the 'dope and impressive' you asked for.

options.label: Goal Lines
options.lineage: a metro map on midnight-blue enamel
options.thesis: Your four goals are four coloured lines; every workout is a station on the way to your goal.
options.viewport: Your line drawn across the screen, the next station lit, your goal as the terminus.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: goals map to lines and workouts to stations. Strong on clarity, weaker on identification for older members who never ride a metro.
options.risk: Reads abstract to members who think in pounds and minutes, not routes.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.thesis: Workouts browse like shows: rows by goal, the focused one grows and tells you what it is.
options.viewport: Continue-watching row with today's workout, then rows per goal.
options.case: Everyone of every age knows this layout, so identification is high; but tracking progress gets pushed behind browsing.
options.risk: Makes it feel like a video library instead of a coach and a plan.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.case: Workouts as coupons is cute but members do not think of exercise as travel.
options.kept: Nothing disappears, it stamps: finished workouts stay stamped on the week.

options.label: Emission Lines
options.case: Too cold and technical for grandparents and beginners.
options.kept: State carried by shape, not only colour.

options.label: Dance Score
options.case: Accurate to movement but unreadable without training.
options.kept: Length equals duration in the workout timer.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.case: A designer's world, not a member's.
options.kept: Monumental numerals for the stats that matter.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fitness tracker: activity rings, cards, a tab bar, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Rings up top, today's stats below, workout cards in a list.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every fitness app by design.
